<!-- Adding or updating a plugin? See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] One file, `plugins/<id>.toml`, named after the plugin's id.
- [ ] Each version's zip is a release asset, and its `sha256` matches (`sha256sum file.zip`).
- [ ] The zip's `plugin.toml` has the same id, version, api and permissions as the entry.
- [ ] I wrote this plugin or have the right to distribute it under its license.
